in_sanskrit.name: हम्सावेनि
in_sanskrit.meaning: हमस: हम, सा: सा, वेनि: वेनु, इ: इति, नि: निश्चित्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is certain to be the goddess of Hamsa (Swan).

in_marathi.name: Hamsaveni
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hamsaveni हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Hamsa, the embodiment of purity and peace, symbolized by the swan. Hamsa is believed to protect from evil and bring prosperity.

in_bengali.name: Hamsaveni
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Swan Goddess
in_bengali.long_meaning: Hamsaveni একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Goddess Hamsa, the embodiment of purity and peace, symbolized by the swan. Hamsa is believed to protect from evil and bring prosperity.
